wallet.sessionLostDescription: Freighter is no longer available. Disconnect and reconnect to restore your session.

subscriptionForm.title: Create Subscription
subscriptionForm.description: Authorize a recurring on-chain payment using your Freighter wallet.
subscriptionForm.merchantAddressHint: The merchant's Stellar account public key — starts with G, 56 characters.
subscriptionForm.tokenAddressHint: The SEP-41 token contract address — starts with C, 56 characters.
subscriptionForm.amountHint: Required. Enter the recurring payment amount in token units.
subscriptionForm.intervalHint: Required. The recurrence cadence for the subscription. Default is 30 days.
subscriptionForm.walletHint: Connect your Freighter wallet to enable submission.

share.title: Subscription share link
share.description: Anyone who scans this QR code will land on a pre-filled subscription form with your merchant address, token, amount, and interval.
share.disabledHint: Enter a merchant address to generate a share link

errors.refreshOrContact: Something went wrong. Refresh the page or contact support.

onboarding.heading: Launch your first recurring payment
onboarding.step1: Install Freighter and switch it to Testnet. Then connect your wallet with the button below.
onboarding.step2: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_ID to frontend/.env.local and restart the app.
onboarding.step3: Fill in the merchant, token, amount, and interval fields. Then authorize the subscription with Freighter.

paymentHistory.title: Payment History
paymentHistory.description: Executed payments and subscription activity will appear here once on-chain event indexing is available.

disconnectedCard.message: Connect your wallet to get started
